description: TMO - Barnet (Charged-For Parking Places) Consolidation Order 2014 is a dataset listed in UK national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by London Borough of Barnet. Traffic Management Orders (TMOs) are legal documents drafted and made by the council, usually under the Road Traffic Regulation Act 1984. They regulate the use of highways for movement and parking and also off street parking areas within the borough by drivers of vehicles and/or pedestrians. Coverage: London Borough of Barnet. The portal files it under the publisher London Borough of Barnet. It offers 31 resource(s) in CSV, PDF. The portal shows 2026-09-25 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-uk-portal.
